def solve(s, names):

import sys

def hamiltonianCycleGraph(vertices):
    # Create an adjacency list representation of the Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
    adjacencyList = {i: set() for i in vertices}
    
    # Build the graph
    for v in vertices:
        for w in vertices:
            if v < w:
                adjacencyList[v].add(w)
    
    # Initialize edge count for all vertices
    edgeCount = {v: 0 for v in vertices}
    
    # Perform DFS starting from the first vertex
    def dfs(vertex):
        for neighbor in adjacencyList[vertex]:
            edgeCount[neighbor] = edgeCount[vertex] + 1
            dfs(neighbor)
    
    dfs(1)

    # The minimum number of edges in an optimal k-encoding is the maximum value in edgeCount
    minEdges = max(edgeCount.values())
